name: Lopus
long_description:
Pointing an AI at all your data is a recipe for disaster - it will confidently lie, hallucinate, and drive your business into the ground.

What if you could trust your AI the way you trust a calculator?

That's Lopus.

We build a self-healing semantic layer that captures your business logic.
Including every metric, every definition, every edge case.
Defined once, and trusted everywhere.

No SQL. No dashboards. No waiting on the data team.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Co-founder and CEO of Lopus AI.

CS @ Dartmouth. Full-stack/infra/ML dev building in public. Extensive experience with LLM-centered ML research. Previously worked on the DIGIHEALS project at DARPA.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Building Lopus - Analytics for the rest of us. 

Ex. 2+ years of award-winning R&D for startups @ DALI Lab, Dartmouth, deep experience in AR/VR development, product & system design. Led multiple ivy league technical teams at research labs, tech consulting groups, & quant teams.
